18.heading: am 3029-3046, bc 975-958
refs: and more than eighty years had elapsed since David, at the age of thirty, began to reign: Abigail must therefore have been grand-daughter to Eliab
and this shows the latitude in which the words son and daughter are used in Scripture.
18.body:
daughter:
Eliab was David's eldest brother; and more than eighty years had elapsed since David, at the age of thirty, began to reign: Abigail must therefore have been grand-daughter to Eliab; and this shows the latitude in which the words son and daughter are used in Scripture.
